steps.title: Get your enrollment clearance form
steps.detail: Go to the Registrar's Office and ask for the enrollment clearance form.

steps.title: Fill up the clearance form
steps.detail: Write your full name, student ID number, last course taken, and incoming course. List every subject you are taking with its subject code and the instructor's name.

steps.title: Sign your clearance at five offices
steps.detail: Sign the form at each office, in this order.

steps.title: Get your grades
steps.detail: Go to Room 107 and get your grades from the department head who handles your grades.

steps.title: Sign your last clearance
steps.detail: Return to the Registrar's Office and sign your last clearance.

steps.title: Get your enrollment permit
steps.detail: Go to the Admin Office and get your permit for the enrollment fee: 2,950 pesos.

steps.title: Pay, then seal your clearance
steps.detail: After paying, go back to the Admin Office. They approve and seal your clearance form, and sign it.

steps.title: Profiling
steps.detail: Go to Slab 1 for profiling: change or double-check your information.

steps.title: Sign your clearance once more
steps.detail: The instructor assigned to you during profiling signs your clearance again.

steps.title: Pass your enrollment form
steps.detail: Go to Faculty, pass your enrollment form, and get your study load.
